caption: The loop closes: the npn collector feeds the pnp base through the n-well, and the pnp collector feeds the npn base through the substrate. The figure uses R_sub = 200 Ω and R_well = 1 kΩ, the values of part (a) of the worked example.

spec.aria: Directed graph of the parasitic npn and pnp transistors closing a loop through the n-well and the p-substrate, each drawn as a collector feeding the other base.
